evidence: Access to the track is signposted approximately 40 km northeast of Haast on SH6 at the Windbag Saddle.
The track up the Moeraki valley initially follows the Haast – Paringa Cattle Track.
Turn left at the junction, following the sign for Horseshoe Flat Hut.
Middle Head Hut is located near the confluence of this creek and the Middle Head branch of the Moeraki River.
Do not attempt to cross in these conditions or if rain is forecast while you are further up the valley, as you will be unable to return to Horseshoe Flat Hut.

doubts: The text never says 'return the same way'; out_and_back is inferred from the valley route ending at Middle Head Hut/Basin with no other exit and from 'you will be unable to return to Horseshoe Flat Hut'. Start F1 (unnamed track meeting Haast Highway) is taken as the signposted Windbag Saddle parking area on SH6, which it is near; the text names no road end explicitly. The Middle Head Basin route has its own heading and time but the page calls it a side-trip, so it is recorded as a side trip, not a way.
